scope: Fixed neural command-response engineering profiles; no odor, ingestion or full-native certification.
handover: Zero command during 960 actual teacher decisions, continuous motor hidden/body/actuator/previous-action state. No teacher queries in1920 autonomous decisions. No resets at command switch.
gates: Original all5 endpoint engineering gates and all6 sensed cycles over entire9.6s autonomous window unchanged. Original world-X forward metric retained. No per-half cycle requirement or relaxed physical threshold.

yaw.frame: Actual thorax world yaw, positive counterclockwise, continuously unwrapped over full trace.
yaw.neutral: No directional yaw criterion; physical gates/cycles still required.
yaw.intermediate: Whole9.6s signed yaw in requested direction >=.005rad.
yaw.switching: Each actual4.8s signed yaw in its requested direction >=.002rad; include transition transient, no grace interval removed.

sampling_geometry: Actual Head xpos/xmat with fixed engineering offsets from existing HEAD_GEOMETRY_AUDIT. Save head and bilateral sensor midpoint each1ms. Distance/path geometry diagnostic only; does not change motor gates or imply food success.
checkpoint: Must be explicitly selected by parent and supplied as absolute --checkpoint plus exact --sha256; checked_motor.load_checked_motor validates training identities. Original baseline physical/runtime identity checked independently through sw.load_student.
selection: Fixed5profiles only. Overall profile suite eligible iff all5 pass. No best-profile substitution. Candidate qualification and launch belong to parent; preparation launches no physics.
sources: Capture profile evaluator, this prereg, strict wrapper, conditional module, original runtime/asset identities, checkpoint and geometry audit; verify immutable inputs after evaluation.
output: Fresh --out directory only; actual1ms fulltrace, actual5ms observations/commands/hidden/mean/policy/applied/source, dense1ms geometry, exact phase counts/handover/switch snapshots, original gates/cycles and signed yaw report. All physical steps are real native integration by unchanged Core.
